content: .{@-पुत्रः@} .²1 son of an honourable man. .²2 the son of a spiritual preceptor. .²3 honorific designation of the son of the elder brother; of a husband by his wife; or of a prince by his general <ab>&c.</ab> .²4 the son of the father-in law, {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} a husband (occurring in every drama; mostly in the vocative case in the last two senses).
